platforms.name: Steam
platforms.mfaNote: Steam Guard Mobile Authenticator (time-based codes) and Steam Guard email codes. Steam does not support passkeys or FIDO2 hardware keys — the mobile authenticator is the strongest option.
scamPatterns: Fake item or trade offers that redirect to a login page
"Free gift card" or "free game" direct messages
Fake Steam Support messages asking for your password or Steam Guard code
Third-party trade sites that ask for your API key

platforms.name: Discord
platforms.mfaNote: Discord supports two-factor authentication via an authenticator app, plus passkeys (passwordless login) and hardware security keys (FIDO2).
scamPatterns: Links that steal your Discord token or session
"Verify your account" QR codes that hand over your session
Fake Discord staff or support direct messages

platforms.name: Epic Games
platforms.mfaNote: Epic supports two-factor authentication via authenticator app, email, or SMS.

platforms.name: EA
platforms.mfaNote: EA supports login verification via authenticator app or email.
scamPatterns: FUT coins or in-game currency scams

platforms.name: Riot Games
platforms.mfaNote: Riot supports two-factor authentication via email and authenticator app.
scamPatterns: "Free Riot Points" or free currency scams

platforms.name: PlayStation
platforms.mfaNote: PlayStation supports 2-step verification via authenticator app or text message, plus passkey sign-in.
scamPatterns: Fake Sony or PlayStation support calls

platforms.name: Xbox
platforms.mfaNote: Xbox accounts use Microsoft two-step verification (authenticator app or passwordless).
scamPatterns: "Free Game Pass" or free subscription scams
